title.zh-CN: 反复黑便与面色苍白 · 6岁男童
title.en: Recurrent melaena and pallor · boy aged 6

summary.zh-CN: 儿童反复消化道出血，既往检查未定位，近期伴腹痛，需要重新整合出血证据与腹部影像。
summary.en: A child has recurrent gastrointestinal bleeding with previously non-localising tests and recent abdominal pain; reassess bleeding evidence and abdominal imaging.

triageNote.zh-CN: 一周来黑便增至每天3–5次，并有左上腹间歇隐痛，面色明显苍白。
triageNote.en: Melaena has increased to 3–5 stools daily for a week, with intermittent left upper abdominal pain and marked pallor.

text.zh-CN: 胃镜、结肠镜及核素扫描未见异常；造影见约8×7 cm腹部肿物压迫小肠，超声见11.0×7.9×4.0 cm蜂窝状囊性病变，CT示腹盆腔囊性占位。
text.en: Upper endoscopy, colonoscopy and isotope scanning were unremarkable; contrast imaging showed an approximately 8 × 7 cm mass compressing small bowel, ultrasound an 11.0 × 7.9 × 4.0 cm honeycomb cystic lesion, and CT a cystic abdominopelvic mass.

text.zh-CN: 小肠及系膜缘多个病灶，切除约70 cm肠段；病理见肠壁各层扩张薄壁血管，部分充满红细胞，报告海绵状血管瘤。
text.en: Multiple small-bowel and mesenteric lesions led to approximately 70 cm resection; dilated thin-walled vessels traversed bowel layers, some filled with red cells, reported as cavernous haemangioma.

text.en: Haemoglobin was 112 g/L on postoperative day 9; the wound healed and discharge followed. At two years there was no recurrent melaena or anaemia, with good growth.

hint.en: Identify localising signs and retain missing information as unknown.

prompt.zh-CN: 常规内镜阴性但持续黑便和严重贫血，下一步推理应是什么？
prompt.en: What reasoning follows negative standard endoscopy with ongoing melaena and severe anaemia?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅当前阶段的检查记录，再比较不同解释。
need.en: Review the current investigation records before comparing explanations.

text.zh-CN: 继续评估小肠来源，并将腹部占位与出血联系
text.en: Investigate a small-bowel source and relate the mass to bleeding

feedback.zh-CN: 常规内镜未覆盖全部小肠，影像已经提供新的定位线索。
feedback.en: Standard endoscopy does not cover the whole small bowel, and imaging provides new localisation.

text.zh-CN: 内镜阴性说明没有消化道出血
text.en: Negative endoscopy excludes gastrointestinal bleeding

feedback.zh-CN: 黑便、强阳性潜血和严重贫血仍构成客观证据。
feedback.en: Melaena, strongly positive occult blood and severe anaemia remain objective evidence.

text.zh-CN: 只考虑骨髓造血失败
text.en: Consider only marrow production failure

feedback.zh-CN: 骨髓记录无特殊异常，而反复黑便支持失血。
feedback.en: Marrow findings were unremarkable while recurrent melaena supports blood loss.

prompt.zh-CN: 后续资料能支持哪一项结论？
prompt.en: Which conclusion is supported by the subsequent records?

need.zh-CN: 先核对后续验证资料，再评估它能和不能说明什么。
need.en: Review the subsequent records before judging what they do and do not establish.

text.zh-CN: 组织学证实肠壁及系膜血管性病变，解释隐匿反复失血
text.en: Histology confirms a bowel-wall/mesenteric vascular lesion explaining recurrent occult loss

feedback.zh-CN: 薄壁血管和病灶范围将形态与临床出血联系起来。
feedback.en: Thin-walled vessels and lesion extent connect morphology with bleeding.

text.zh-CN: 无皮肤血管瘤即可否定肠道血管病变
text.en: Absence of skin lesions excludes an intestinal vascular lesion

feedback.zh-CN: 皮肤阴性并不否定组织已经证实的肠内病变。
feedback.en: No skin lesion cannot negate histologically proven intestinal disease.

text.zh-CN: 影像称囊性就证明是无关的单纯囊肿
text.en: Cystic imaging proves an unrelated simple cyst

feedback.zh-CN: 影像外形不等于病理性质。
feedback.en: Imaging shape is not equivalent to histological identity.

prompt.zh-CN: 结合严重贫血和广泛病灶，怎样制定安全计划？
prompt.en: What safe plan follows severe anaemia and extensive disease?

need.zh-CN: 先形成工作判断，再核对后续证据和安全边界。
need.en: Form a working interpretation, then review subsequent evidence and safety limits.

text.zh-CN: 儿科消化和外科共同评估出血稳定性、病灶范围及保留肠段
text.en: Joint paediatric gastroenterology/surgical assessment of bleeding stability, extent and bowel preservation

feedback.zh-CN: 既需控制失血，也需避免广泛切除后的营养损害。
feedback.en: Control of blood loss must be balanced against nutritional harm from extensive resection.

text.zh-CN: 忽视肠腔受压，直接把吞胶囊当作无条件方案
text.en: Ignore bowel compression and prescribe capsule investigation unconditionally

feedback.zh-CN: 影像有肠腔受压，应由专科评估通过性和检查选择，不能机械套用一般路径。
feedback.en: Compression requires specialist patency and modality assessment rather than mechanical use of a general pathway.

text.zh-CN: 因症状曾自行缓解而不处理当前严重贫血
text.en: Ignore current severe anaemia because earlier episodes improved

feedback.zh-CN: 缓解并未阻止长期复发及严重失血。
feedback.en: Temporary improvement did not prevent recurrence and major blood loss.

text.zh-CN: 查清首发症状与病程
text.en: Establish presenting symptoms and course

text.zh-CN: 补充伴随症状及相关病史
text.en: Elicit associated symptoms and relevant background

text.zh-CN: 明确过敏资料的证据边界
text.en: Establish the evidence boundary for allergy information

text.zh-CN: 核对与当前表现相关的体征
text.en: Review signs relevant to the presentation

text.zh-CN: 调阅早期关键检查
text.en: Review the key early investigations

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即正确整合早期证据
text.en: Integrate the early evidence correctly on the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 核对后续验证资料
text.en: Review subsequent corroborating evidence

text.zh-CN: 首次正确说明后续证据的强度和边界
text.en: State the strength and limits of subsequent evidence correctly on the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 首次选择兼顾出血与肠段保留的专科计划
text.en: Choose specialist planning balancing bleeding control and bowel preservation on the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 复盘原报告治疗及转归
text.en: Review reported treatment and outcome

text.zh-CN: 清楚说明证据与不确定性
text.en: Explain evidence and uncertainty clearly

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 说明阴性常规内镜不能排除小肠病变。；承认准确输血经过、铁指标、全部遗传/血管异常评估及两年后的结局。，用复述确认理解。
judgeGuidance.en: Explain that Negative standard endoscopy does not exclude small-bowel disease.; acknowledge Exact transfusion course, iron indices, comprehensive vascular/genetic assessment and outcomes beyond two years. and check understanding through teach-back.

knowledge.zh-CN: 帮助比较已经调阅的证据，区分工作诊断、确证资料和未解决问题，不提前透露结局。
knowledge.en: Help compare evidence already reviewed, distinguish working diagnoses from corroboration and unresolved questions, and do not disclose outcomes early.

conclusion.zh-CN: 反复小肠失血最终由小肠及肠系膜海绵状血管瘤的手术病理解释。
conclusion.en: Operative histology of small-bowel and mesenteric cavernous haemangioma explained recurrent small-bowel blood loss.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 阴性常规内镜不能排除小肠病变。
keyReasoning.en: Negative standard endoscopy does not exclude small-bowel disease.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 囊性占位的性质需要病理佐证。
keyReasoning.en: The nature of a cystic mass requires pathological corroboration.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 出血控制和保留吸收功能需要同时考虑。
keyReasoning.en: Bleeding control and preservation of absorptive function must be considered together.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 把重复失血的时间线与阴性检查的范围相联系。
teachingPoints.en: Relate recurrent bleeding to the anatomical reach of negative tests.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 不要将普通小肠出血检查路径直接套用于肠腔受压的儿童。
teachingPoints.en: Do not apply general small-bowel bleeding pathways indiscriminately to a child with bowel compression.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 手术后改善是报告结局，不能定义所有同类病灶的唯一疗法。
teachingPoints.en: Postoperative improvement is a reported outcome, not proof of one treatment for every similar lesion.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例报告不能证明疗法的普遍有效性；历史处置只用于复盘。当前安全选项是教学推理，不提供可自行执行的药物剂量。
boundaries.en: A single report cannot establish general treatment efficacy; historical care is reviewed as evidence. Safety options are educational reasoning without self-administered drug doses.

unknowns.zh-CN: 准确输血经过、铁指标、全部遗传/血管异常评估及两年后的结局。
unknowns.en: Exact transfusion course, iron indices, comprehensive vascular/genetic assessment and outcomes beyond two years.
